scenes.brief: Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S03 (attention). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "attention". Variants: attention (a token sequence such as 「台積電 生產 AI 晶片」 shown as tokens → embeddings → Q/K/V; hovering or focusing a token shows its attention weights as arcs; multi-head colouring), layers (a stack of Transformer blocks with attention + FFN + residuals, tokens flowing upward), moe (a router sending each token to the top-2 of 8 experts, with load-balance bars). Steps go from 「文字變成 token」 to multi-head attention to the KV cache.

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S04 (train-infer). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "train-infer". Variants: training (a GPU cluster doing forward/backward passes with a gradient all-reduce ring and a loss curve going down), inference (requests batched into a GPU; prefill vs decode phases; KV cache growing; tokens streaming out), pipeline (the data → filter → dedupe → tokenize → pretrain → post-train (SFT/RLHF) → eval → deploy conveyor, used on the devtools/MLOps segment page).

Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "scaling-surface". A 3D loss surface over log(parameters) × log(training tokens) with height = loss, rendered as a smooth shaded mesh with contour lines; an iso-compute curve (C ≈ 6ND) slider; the compute-optimal ridge (Chinchilla, about 20 tokens per parameter) highlighted; markers for illustrative model sizes (labelled 「示意」). Steps: what the axes mean → bigger is better → a fixed compute budget → the optimal ridge → beyond: inference-time scaling (a note card).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S05 (preset euv), plus architecture.md seg-semi-equipment-materials. Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "euv-litho". Variants: euv (the EUV light path in the correct order: tin droplet generator → CO2 laser pre-pulse and main pulse → 13.5 nm plasma → collector mirror → illuminator mirrors → reflective photomask (reticle) on a mask stage → projection optics (6 mirrors) → wafer on the wafer stage; the whole system in a vacuum chamber; animated droplets and light pulses), high-na (the anamorphic projection optics with NA 0.55 vs 0.33, a half-field exposure, larger mirrors; a side-by-side NA comparison). Steps cover the light source, mirrors, mask, projection, and resolution (the Rayleigh criterion as a text card).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S05 (wafer-transistor). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "wafer-transistor". Variants: wafer (a 300 mm wafer with a die grid, zooming into one die and into its metal layers and transistors), transistor (a morph from planar → FinFET → GAA nanosheet → CFET, showing the gate, channel, source/drain and the gate-all-around wrapping), bspdn (backside power delivery: the power rails move to the back of the wafer and the signal wires stay on the front; a before/after comparison).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S06 (cowos). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "cowos". Variants: cowos (an exploded view with an explode slider: package substrate (ABF) → C4 bumps → silicon interposer (CoWoS-S) or an RDL interposer with LSI bridges (CoWoS-L) → micro-bumps → central logic dies (GPU, 2 reticle-sized dies) + 8 HBM stacks around them; a toggle for CoWoS-S vs CoWoS-L), soic (SoIC hybrid bonding: dies bonded face to face with copper-to-copper pads and no bumps, showing the pitch reduction compared with micro-bumps).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S07 (hbm). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "hbm". Variants: hbm (an HBM stack: a base logic die + 12 (or 16) DRAM core dies connected by TSVs and micro-bumps (MR-MUF / TC-NCF fill), sitting next to the GPU on the interposer; data flowing up and down the TSVs; a 1024-bit (HBM3E) vs 2048-bit (HBM4) interface toggle), hierarchy (a memory-hierarchy tower: registers → SRAM/L2 → HBM → DDR/LPDDR → SSD → HDD, showing capacity vs bandwidth vs latency on log scales).

Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "chip-floorplan". A large AI accelerator die rendered as a 3D 「城市」 floorplan: blocks for compute cores (SM / tensor-core arrays), L2/SRAM cache banks, the network-on-chip mesh with moving packets, HBM PHYs along the edges, SerDes/IO, PCIe/CXL, a CPU/management complex, and a power-delivery grid. Hover each block for its IP type and whether it is typically licensed IP (Arm, Synopsys, Cadence, Rambus and others) or custom; a zoom step into standard cells (rows of logic cells and wires). Steps follow the EDA flow: spec → RTL → synthesis → place and route → signoff → tape-out (as captions).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S08 (gpu-scale). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "gpu-scale". Variants: chip (GPU package → board → compute tray → NVL72 rack → a pod of racks, as zoom levels with a step-through camera tour), die (a GPU die opened up: SM array, tensor cores, L2 cache, HBM stacks, NVLink I/O), rack (an exploded rack-scale system: compute trays, NVLink switch trays, power shelves, a liquid-cooling manifold with CDU hoses, a busbar; labels for typical ODM and supplier roles such as 機櫃組裝、散熱、電源、滑軌, marked 「示意」).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S09 (network). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "network". Variants: scale-up (an NVLink domain inside a rack: GPUs fully connected through NVLink switch chips, high-bandwidth packet streams), scale-out (a leaf-spine / rail-optimized Ethernet or InfiniBand fabric across racks with packet flows and an all-reduce animation; congestion hotspots), cpo (copper DAC vs pluggable optical transceiver vs co-packaged optics: the switch ASIC with optical engines around it, lasers and fibres, and a power-per-bit comparison card).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S10 (datacenter). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "datacenter". Variants: overview (a cutaway AI data hall: rows of racks, hot/cold aisle containment, a cooling plant, an electrical room), liquid (air cooling vs direct-to-chip liquid cooling vs immersion: coolant loops through cold plates → CDU → facility water → cooling tower; heat colour flows; a PUE card), power-chain (grid → substation → medium-voltage switchgear → transformer → UPS / batteries → PDU or busway → rack PSU → 800 V DC option → chip voltage regulators, with energy flowing and losses shown).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S11 (energy). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "energy". Variants: grid (a regional grid feeding a GW-scale AI campus: gas turbines, a nuclear plant / SMRs, solar + battery storage, transmission lines and a substation; scale comparisons such as 1 GW ≈ one large nuclear reactor, shown as 示意), onsite (behind-the-meter generation on the campus: gas turbines / reciprocating engines / fuel cells, a battery buffer, flexible load). Steps: demand, sources, transmission, onsite generation, and bottlenecks (turbine lead times, grid interconnection queues).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S12 (cloud-globe). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "cloud-globe". Data comes from the page as {campuses:[{name, lat, lon, operator, mw, status}]}; ship a fixture with about 25 real major campuses (Stargate Abilene, xAI Colossus Memphis, Meta Hyperion Louisiana, Microsoft Fairwater Wisconsin, Amazon Rainier Indiana and others, marked 示意 in the fixture). Use kit Globe + ArcRibbons. Markers sized by MW and coloured by status; hover cards; a slow rotation; a filter by operator type (hyperscaler / neocloud / sovereign).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S13 (model-galaxy). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "model-galaxy". Data: the models data shape in docs/SCENES.md (capability, costIndex, openness, released, lab, origin, kind, href). Use Axes3D with labelled axes (能力 / 成本（對數） / 開放程度), stars coloured by origin (美國 / 中國 / 歐洲 / 台灣 / 其他) and sized by tier, a release-date slider showing the frontier moving over time, click to navigate to /models/<id>/, and a filter by kind (LLM / image / video and so on). Fixture: about 20 representative families (示意).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S14 (agent-loop). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "agent-loop". An agent loop: a central LLM 「大腦」, plan → act (tool calls flying out as arcs to MCP server satellites: search, code execution, database, browser/computer use, file system) → observe (results flowing back) → memory (short-term context + a long-term memory store) → the next step; a permission / guardrail ring; a prompt-injection threat shown as a red packet blocked by the guardrails in a later step.

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S15 (physical-ai). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "physical-ai". Variants: robot (a humanoid or a dual-arm robot doing a pick-and-place: sensors (cameras, force/torque) → a VLA model (vision-language-action) → actuators and joints, with sim-to-real shown as a mirrored simulation ghost), autonomy (an autonomous car in a stylised street: a lidar point-cloud sweep, camera frustums, detected objects as boxes, a planned trajectory, an end-to-end model card).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S16 (company-globe). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "company-globe". Data: the companies data shape in docs/SCENES.md (several hundred companies with lat, lon, layer, segment, tier, revenueUsdM, href, city). Use kit Globe. Markers coloured by layer token (--layer-*), sized by tier or revenue, with city clustering (stacked columns for dense hubs such as 新竹, 台北, 矽谷, 深圳, 東京, 首爾); a filter by layer (HTML controls in the scene controls slot, as documented in SCENE-CONTRACT); hover cards; click navigates. Performance: InstancedMesh with screen-space picking. Fixture: generate it from src/data/roster/*.yaml (hq lat/lon) with a small script kept inside your folder, or hand-pick about 120 entries.

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S17 (roadmap-tunnel). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "roadmap-tunnel". Data: the trends data shape in docs/SCENES.md (milestones with date, label, status). A time tunnel 2024 → 2031 with four lanes (硬體 / 軟體 / 市場 / 政策) as rails; milestone markers (done = solid, expected = outline, speculative = dashed or glowing); scroll or a slider moves the camera through time; hover shows the milestone and its trend title; click navigates to /trends/<id>/. Fixture: about 30 milestones based on the trends index (示意).

Detailed design: research/design/scenes3d.md section B entry S18 (taiwan-map). Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "taiwan-map". Data: the taiwan data shape in docs/SCENES.md (sites with lat, lon, kind, companies). Use src/data/geo/taiwan.json and kit projectTw. An extruded Taiwan island with county outlines; towers for science parks and clusters (新竹科學園區, 中科, 南科, 竹北, 林口, 桃園, 高雄楠梓 and others) with height = number of AI-chain companies and colour by dominant segment; arcs from Taiwan to the world (US, Japan, Korea, Europe) showing exports of chips and servers; hover cards list companies. Fixture: about 20 sites with real coordinates.

Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "learn-mountain". Data: the curriculum data shape in docs/SCENES.md (38 articles with level, order, track, prereqs, href). A stylised mountain with three terraces (入門 at the base, 進階 midway, 深入 at the summit); article nodes on their terrace, coloured by track; prerequisite paths as glowing trails between nodes; hover shows the title; click opens the article; a step tour climbs the mountain. Calm and inviting, not cluttered: labels appear on hover/focus or for the nearest nodes only.

Required variants and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "embedding-space". Variants: semantic (about 120 zh-TW words as points in a 3D semantic space, forming clusters such as 晶片 / 記憶體 / 動物 / 城市 / 情緒; a vector-arithmetic demo (國王 − 男人 + 女人 ≈ 女王, or 東京 − 日本 + 台灣 ≈ 台北) with arrows; nearest-neighbour highlight on hover), rag (a query point flies into a document-chunk cloud, the top-k nearest chunks light up and are pulled into the 「上下文視窗」 box feeding the LLM). Positions are hand-designed or computed deterministically (示意), with no external model downloads.
